A '''Gank''' pulled a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] on the prone form of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] after the [[Gank/Legends|Gank's]] [[Unidentified Gank thug 1|partner]], another member of the Gank [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Limb/Legends|backhanded]] the Sullustan on the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]]&ndash;[[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after Dhur accidentally bumped into them while drunk. When the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I-5YQ]] came to Dhur's aid, the Ganks fled the scene.
